subject: Implement per-thread conversation memory with ModelMessage persistence
description:
Build `capo/memory/conversation.py` — per-(`user_id`, `thread_id`) `ModelMessage` history persisted via Pydantic AI's `ModelMessage` JSON serialization. Composite primary key `(user_id, thread_id, message_index)`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `thread_id = "amc:<channel_id>"`.
- [ ] `load_history(user_id, thread_id, session_id)` returns the messages for the current session in order.
- [ ] `append_messages(user_id, thread_id, session_id, messages)` writes via the BEGIN IMMEDIATE retry helper.
- [ ] Composite PK `(user_id, thread_id, message_index)` enforced.
- [ ] On each turn, the dispatcher loads all messages for `(user_id, thread_id)` in the current session and feeds them into `agent.run(... message_history=...)`.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] First message in a thread: returns empty history, session is created (see session task).
- [ ] Two writers for the same thread serialize via the retry helper.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: roundtrip Pydantic AI `ModelMessage` JSON serialize/deserialize (anchors spike S-4 risk note in §13)
• Integration: append + load preserves order across turns
• Integration: two threads' histories never bleed into each other

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.7, 7.3, 9.1
